new_assertions.title: relative transporter is an even involution with two disjoint swaps
new_assertions.body: The definitionally composed relative transporter 197502 swaps slots 0 and 1, swaps slots 2 and 3, fixes slot 4, and applying it twice returns every represented slot to itself; its represented parity bit is 0.

new_assertions.title: absolute sign plus common second action does not determine route phase
new_assertions.body: The two shortest routes both have accumulated transporter-sign bit 1 and the same second source-frame action slot 2, yet their computed route-phase bits are 0 and 1; the pair (absolute sign, second action) does not determine route phase on this witness.

add_fixed: the two shortest routes share their second source-frame action and absolute transporter parity while their route phases differ
remove_alternatives: absolute transporter parity together with the common second source-frame action is sufficient to determine the shortest-route phase
retain_open: full non-parity transporter/orientation structure matters on some obstruction components
a relabeling-invariant endpoint/residual relation subsumes the needed distinction
other action-history features matter outside the shortest pair

rejected_candidates.body: The first differing source-frame action causes the phase difference.
rejected_candidates.reason: The pair differs at the first action, but the represented facts do not prove causal sufficiency.
